text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly in the past day, with BTC holding stronger than most altcoins, while BTC dominance at 58.5% suggests confidence in the largest asset despite the pullback. The Fear & Greed Index remains in greed territory and rising, indicating investors still see opportunity despite the red day. Total volume at $89B is solid, though the broad-based decline across major alts hints that some profit-taking or caution may be tempering the rally rather than signaling panic.
